newsitem.title: FRANCE: Car bomb toll in Algeria rises to eight dead.
newsitem.headline: Car bomb toll in Algeria rises to eight dead.

text.p: A car bomb killed eight people and wounded 25 in the Algerian capital late on Wednesday, Algerian newspapers said on Thursday.
Security forces had given a provisional toll of three dead and 25 wounded, shortly after the bomb exploded in the El Biar district of Algiers at 7.40 p.m. (1840 GMT).
More than 170 civilians have been killed by Moslem rebels in Blida province and the neighbouring Tipaza region in the past week. Most were killed in night raids on isolated communities.
About 60,000 people have been killed since early 1992 when the authorities cancelled a general election in which the radical Islamic Salvation Front (FIS) had taken a commanding lead.
